name: com.quiroads/clinic-marketing
title: QuiroAds Clinic Marketing Tools
description: Clinic marketing playbooks and tools: Meta ads access, health ad rules, lead follow-up, care plans

tools.name: get_clinic_marketing_playbook
tools.description: Returns the full text of one of four MIT-licensed playbooks (agent skills) for people who market health clinics, so the assistant can follow the method step by step: meta_ads_access_audit (who owns and controls a clinic's Meta ad account, Page, Instagram, dataset and WhatsApp), health_ad_compliance (reviewing an ad or landing page against Meta and Google policies and the health-advertising rules of Spain, the UK, the US and Australia; add country for that country's rules), lead_follow_up (a WhatsApp, SMS and call follow-up system for new enquiries) and care_plan_conversion (first visit, report of findings, care plans and retention). Each playbook says when its rules were checked.

topic.description: Which playbook: meta_ads_access_audit (who owns and controls a clinic's Meta ads setup), health_ad_compliance (reviewing an ad, post or landing page against Meta and Google policies and health-advertising rules), lead_follow_up (answering and following up new patient enquiries) or care_plan_conversion (first visits, care plans and keeping patients).

country.description: Only for health_ad_compliance: also return that country's rules (es Spain, uk United Kingdom, us United States, au Australia).

tools.name: scan_health_ad_copy
tools.description: Scans the text of a health clinic's ad, post or landing page (up to 4,000 characters) for phrases that Meta and Google ad policies and the health-advertising rules of Spain, the UK, the US and Australia restrict: testimonials and reviews, promises of a cure, a guarantee or a result, superlatives, questions or statements about the reader's condition (Meta), before-and-after, deadlines and fear, and titles such as Dr. Each finding quotes the phrase with its rule, source link, certainty, severity and a safer pattern, and the result lists what a phrase scan cannot judge (images, the landing page, evidence, registration, offer terms). It is a first pass, not a review: it never says whether an ad can be published. Leave out patient names.

text.description: The ad text, post or landing page copy to scan (up to 4,000 characters). Leave out patient names.

language.description: Language of the answer: es or en. The scan reads both languages either way.

country.description: The clinic's country, for its health-advertising law: es Spain (with the EU rules), uk, us or au. Without it only the platform rules are scanned.

platform.description: Where the ad runs. Without it both platforms' rules are scanned.

tools.name: calculate_lead_funnel
tools.description: Works out a health clinic's lead follow-up metrics from its own weekly counts, per source (all, Meta, Google, website, phone, other): contacted ÷ leads, booked ÷ leads, attended ÷ booked and lead → patient, the median time to first response and, with ad spend, the cost per lead, per booking and per new patient. A metric without its counts comes back as pending with the count it needs; nothing is filled with averages. Counts only: never send names, phone numbers or other lead data.

source.description: Where these leads came from: all (every source together), meta, google, website, phone or other.

leads.description: Leads that arrived that week from this source: a count, not a percentage.

contacted.description: Of those leads, how many replied or spoke to the clinic: a count, not a percentage.

booked.description: Of those leads, how many have a first visit booked: a count, not a percentage.

attended.description: Of those leads, how many came to the first visit («won»): a count, not a percentage.

median_first_response_minutes.description: Time to first response, in minutes: from arrival (or from opening time, out of hours) to the clinic's first message or call; the week's median.

ad_spend.description: What the clinic spent on ads for this source that week, in the currency given: it gives the cost per lead, per booking and per new patient.

rows.description: One week of the clinic's own counts, one row per source (each source once; all for every source together): the leads that arrived that week, and how many of them have replied, booked and come so far. Leave out any count the clinic does not have: it is never estimated.

currency.description: Currency of ad_spend: EUR, GBP, USD or AUD. Without it, money is written as a plain number.

tools.name: calculate_care_plan_numbers
tools.description: Works out a health clinic's care plan numbers from its own monthly counts: first visit → report, report → plan, first visit → plan, plan completed, renewal and reactivation. Given the clinic's own plan options and pay-per-visit price, it adds the price per visit of each option and its saving against paying per visit, largest option first. It never suggests visit counts, frequency, plan length or prices. Counts and prices only: never send patient names or records.

visit_1.description: Patients whose visit 1 (the assessment) was in the month counted: a count, not a percentage.

visit_2.description: Of those, patients who came to visit 2 (the report of findings): a count, not a percentage.

started_plan.description: Of those, patients who started a plan, as the clinic defines it: a count, not a percentage.

reassessed.description: Of those who started a plan, patients who reached the reassessment: a count, not a percentage.

continued.description: Of those reassessed, patients who continued after the reassessment (new phase or maintenance): a count, not a percentage.

lapsed_messaged.description: Lapsed patients the clinic messaged to come back: a count, not a percentage.

reactivated.description: Of those lapsed patients messaged, patients who booked again: a count, not a percentage.

plan_options.description: The clinic's own plan options (one to five), as it already offers them: the visits each includes and its total price. Leave it out if the clinic has none: options are never suggested.

visits.description: Visits this option includes, as the clinic offers it: a whole number from 1.

price.description: Total price of this option, in the currency given.

pay_per_visit_price.description: What the clinic charges for one visit paid on its own, in the currency given: with plan_options, it gives each option's saving against paying per visit.

currency.description: Currency of the prices: EUR, GBP, USD or AUD. Without it, money is written as a plain number.

tools.name: about_quiroads
tools.description: Facts about QuiroAds, the publisher of these tools: what the agency does, its four free agent skills and how to install them, its free report on the cost of a new chiropractic patient, and links to its services and contact pages. Use it only when the user asks about QuiroAds. lang: en (default) or es.

lang.description: Language of the answer: en (default) or es.
